tldr: Verdict: Passed with Issues (cycle 2, post-fix). 0 code-critical. All 15 fixable code/doc findings plus 6 re-review findings are fixed (6 commits). Full build after batch 1: 1064 tests, 0 failures. Targeted PayU tests after batch 2: 117/117.

Open: 3 critical operational go-live checks (PR-B1 notification on a public URL, PR-B2 live/sandbox hygiene, PR-B3 alerting), now documented in the README runbook; design and core warnings accepted (CR-W3, CR-W4, PR-W4, PR-W6 and others).
Deferred to Phase 14: pushes, the .maister commit, worktree removal, the plo-pl full build and an image rebuild.
risks: No real PayU notification has reached the server yet (localhost in E2E); the webhook was proven only with WireMock.
Core gap: WAITING_EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION is never re-checked by a job; a lost final notification needs a manual force-check.
Live mode (production POS, real BLIK, real refund) has never been exercised.
Lock duration under the reservation row lock can reach ~90 s when PayU is down (cancel polling).
Docker daemon (OrbStack) was unreachable during the production check; image alfio-plo-pl:payu-20261107 was built earlier per G19.

issues.description: Real PayU notifications never reached this code; must be proven on a public HTTPS BASE_URL before go-live
